why: hq_backup_snapshot copies public tables and auth accounts only; its own header and the restore doc say Storage files are left out on purpose, and nothing in deploy/ or scripts/ copies Storage

Copies live only in the HQ Worker's KV (wrangler.jsonc:91) with a 7-day expiry (backup.js KEEP_SECONDS); no second store anywhere. But the data it protects lives in Supabase, a different provider, so losing the Cloudflare account loses the backups, not the data; and 7 days is the promise in the privacy page, chosen on purpose

gym_page_reports is written by gym_page_report_send but no HQ, Worker or migration ever reads it (grep finds no reader), and hq_hide_gym_page has no caller in deploy/hq. Part overstated: HQ does have a per-gym 'Switch the web page off' button (0090, apps/hq/public/logic.js:925-934) that stops the page opening, so a page can be taken down once someone hears of it

HQ's manual confirm calls apply_gym_payment, which keeps plan Pro and writes a gym_plan_changes row (0063:259-282); the only thing that applies it is hq_billing_daily, called only by runBillingDaily, which returns 'not set up' unless var BILLING is 'test' with keys (billing.js:62,412); wrangler.jsonc sets no BILLING var

The HQ delete-gym route runs hq_delete_gym and removes Storage files only (api.js:575-592); no code anywhere deletes pay_connections or pay_requests rows (grep of DELETE FROM in deploy/ finds none), and wipeSpentKeys only blanks keys after a desk Disconnect (pay.js:1009-1016), against the 30-day promise in data-agreement.html:58

flushPending drops the kept push only on STALE (cloud.ts:1050-1053); a FINAL_REFUSAL (OWNER_ONLY, SUSPENDED, plan refusals, cloud.ts:432) is rethrown with pending kept, so every later action re-sends it first (1162) and the poll swallows the error (920-925), while pushOnce treats the same refusals as final (1076-1081). Needs a no-answer save followed by a status change, and a page reload clears the in-memory push

A failed phoneContents() becomes zeros (BackupFilePanels.tsx:211), so hasData is false (298) and onReplace restores at once with no question (265-269); the Drive path does ask but a failed count reads as 0 removed (BackupCard.tsx:258-264). Softened: the file restore still offers Undo afterwards (setUndo(r.undo), line 252) except on the welcome screen, and the count failing while the restore succeeds is rare

stats.tsx:89-90 turns a failed body-weight or analytics read into null with no log, so hasWeight is false / strength empty, and strengthEmpty (progressTop.ts:350-355) shows 'Add your body weight' or 'No score yet' advice. Effect is wrong advice on a rare local read failure, no data lost

switchesOf catches any read error and returns both switches ON with no log (paySwitches.js:23-30); saveSwitches fills the untouched switch from that read (33-37), so a failed read during one save writes the other back to ON. Softer in effect: the same request needs D1 again for the gym's payment account, so a pay link mostly fails too, and money would still go to the gym's own account

In the live definition (0061 is the last gym_create_online), free_trial stays true unless a checked proof is sent (0061:169-172); without a proof the only bar is signup_check_required, and the panel falls back to a call without the proof (api.ts:57-62). True in code; the live value of signup_check_required was not read

The live staff guard _staff_write_ok (last defined in 0019) checks only payment and membership records and returns for kind 'member' (0019:34-35), so data.passCompany written by a desk login is accepted; the form shows PassField to every role with no allowed() check (MemberFormSheet.tsx:339-351), and 0055 then treats the member as a pass holder with no end

The evidence cites 0047, but 0048 (applied live 3 Nov 2026) replaced _challenge_results so a finished challenge's winners are marked 'confirm', not 'pending' (0048:396), and free days are added only when the owner presses Give in owner_confirm_challenge_reward (0048:412-432); 0091 keeps that. The finding's own expected fix (owner approves winners first) is already live

owner_add_entry_machine (last defined in 0059) checks only serial format and DUPLICATE_SERIAL, first come first served, with no proof of possession (0059:84-91); the handler then routes every punch by serial alone (handler.ts:115). Owner key needed, but a free gym is easy to make. Not live: the entry machine service is not switched on, so S3 until it is

member_join (last defined in 0020) stores any p_phone unchecked (0020:155-157); owner_app_members (last in 0008) returns that join phone (0008:152), and the admin app matches app members to its list and message targets by it (audience.ts:129-142, 196-207). Today's app sends no number at join (gymApi.ts:85-87), so it needs a crafted direct call with the gym code

member_copy_put (only definition, 0032) needs just a signed-in account (auth.uid), takes 200 items a call, each up to 32 KB (0032:87, 147), and caps an account at 30,000 rows (0032:117-118, 154) with no daily budget: about 1 GB per throwaway Google account against a database shared by every gym
